about: Multi-turn Tiny Apps tester scenarios for the live smoke harness (module_work/live_smoke/run.py flow). PUBLIC documents only: Review-suite document ids (Mecklenburg County standard details, UFC manuals, the app's sample calc packages, planlens synthetic fixtures), {"file": ...} from geotech-references/docs (FHWA/UFC only), {"sample": ...} from funhouse_agent/eval_samples, {"render": ...} screenshots cut from those. Every flow runs as a Tiny Apps user (IIS header identity LIVESMOKE\tester) unless it names another; SharePoint is the local fake library. Step keys: upload | paste (+say) | say | new_conversation | open ("previous" or an index) | restart | restore; "as" picks a session. 'cost' is a rough tier for --max-cost; 'expect' is soft (whether the flow exercised the plumbing it was written for), never a pass/fail.

flows.title: Review page: upload a sheet, automatic orientation, a question

steps.say: What is this sheet's number and title, and what scale is it drawn at?

flows.title: Review page: Word memo, then a follow-up that edits the same memo

steps.say: Review this submittal against its own stated requirements and write the findings up as a Word memo I can download.
Add a one-line summary at the very top of that memo and save it again under the same name.

flows.title: Review page: a marked-up PDF of contradictions

steps.say: Mark up the PDF: put a review comment on each place where the document contradicts itself, and give me the marked-up copy.

flows.title: Review page: markup, then 'save it to SharePoint and send me the link'

steps.say: Put a note on the title block of this sheet saying 'Checked - live smoke test' and give me the marked-up PDF.
Save the marked-up PDF to SharePoint and send me the link.

flows.title: Review page: plot from a report's lab table, then the data as CSV

steps.say: Plot moisture content against depth for every sample in the laboratory summary table, with depth increasing downward.
Now give me the same data as a CSV file.

flows.title: Review page: a CSV table, then 'can I have that as Excel?'

steps.say: Put the boring summary - boring, ground elevation, depth and groundwater - into a table I can download as a CSV file.
Can I have that as an Excel workbook instead?

flows.title: Review page: 'get <file> from SharePoint and review it' (no upload)

steps.say: Get ufc_3_220_04fa_2004.pdf from SharePoint (it's in the uploaded references folder) and tell me what it covers, chapter by chapter.

flows.title: Review page: find a report on SharePoint by description, download, extract

steps.say: There's a geotechnical report for Harbour Road somewhere in our SharePoint. Find it, download it and list the borings it describes with their depths.

flows.title: Review page: upload a sheet, then paste a screenshot with a question

steps.say: Here's a screenshot of part of the sheet. What does the text in this part say, and which detail is it in?

flows.title: Review page: two people on one host - per-user folders stay apart

steps.say: What scale is this sheet at?
What is this detail for?
List every file you have in this conversation, with its full name.
Do you have a sheet called 10.17a.pdf anywhere? If so, what is it?

flows.title: Review page: Word memo, host restart, restore from SharePoint, edit the old memo

steps.say: Write a short Word memo summarising this submittal.
Open the memo you wrote earlier, add a line at the end saying 'Reviewed again after a restore', and save it as a new file.

flows.title: Review page: two conversations, reopen the first, ask for a Word summary

steps.say: What is this sheet?
What is this sheet?
Remind me which sheet we discussed in this conversation and write me a one-paragraph Word summary of it.

flows.title: Review page: a 538-page UFC and an every-page ask

steps.say: Go through every page of this document and list every table title with the page it is on.

flows.title: Review page: drawn tags on a sheet set, results as a CSV

steps.say: Find every FBG callout on every sheet and give me a CSV with the sheet number and where on the sheet each one is.

flows.title: Review page: check a calc package's arithmetic, Word memo

steps.say: Check the arithmetic in this calculation package and write me a Word memo listing anything that does not add up.

flows.title: Review page: a 10-sheet set, a note on every title block, one marked-up PDF

steps.say: On every sheet of this set, put a note on the title block giving the sheet number, and give me one marked-up PDF of the whole set.

flows.title: Review page: a measured distance on a re-plotted site plan

steps.say: How far apart are borings B-1 and B-4, in feet?

flows.title: Geotech page: bearing capacity with a calc package PDF

steps.say: Compute the ultimate and allowable bearing capacity of a 2 m square footing 1 m deep in sand (phi = 32 degrees, unit weight 19 kN/m3, factor of safety 3) and give me a calculation package as a PDF.

flows.title: Geotech page: settlement memo, then 'save it to SharePoint and send me the link'

steps.say: Estimate the consolidation settlement of a 3 m square footing carrying 150 kPa, founded 1 m deep on 6 m of normally consolidated clay (Cc = 0.30, e0 = 0.90, unit weight 18 kN/m3, water table at the ground surface), and write it up as a Word memo.
Save the memo to SharePoint and send me the link.

flows.title: Geotech page: a DIGGS file for two borings

steps.say: Make a DIGGS file for two borings. B-1 at 38.8977 N, 77.0365 W, ground elevation 12.0 m: 0-3 m brown silty SAND (SM), 3-8 m grey lean CLAY (CL), 8-12 m dense sandy GRAVEL (GW); groundwater at 2.5 m. B-2 at 38.8980 N, 77.0360 W, ground elevation 11.5 m: 0-2.5 m SM, 2.5-9 m CL, 9-12 m GW; groundwater at 2.0 m.

flows.title: Geotech page: a slope cross-section exported to DXF

steps.say: Export this slope cross-section to a DXF I can open in CAD: ground surface through (0, 10), (10, 10), (25, 0) and (40, 0) m; a clay layer boundary through (0, 5) and (40, -2); the water table through (0, 7), (25, 0) and (40, 0).

flows.title: Geotech page: a plot from typed data

steps.say: Plot SPT N60 against depth for these readings - 1.5 m: 6, 3.0 m: 9, 4.5 m: 14, 6.0 m: 18, 7.5 m: 25, 9.0 m: 31 - with depth increasing downward.

flows.title: Geotech page: upload a section DXF, slope analysis, calc package PDF

steps.say: Here is a cross-section DXF. Import it, run a slope stability analysis with reasonable soil parameters that you state, and give me a calculation package PDF.

flows.title: Geotech page: upload a DIGGS file, plot the borings, CSV of layers

steps.say: Read the borings in this DIGGS file, plot them, and give me a CSV of the layers.

flows.title: Geotech page: fetch a UFC from SharePoint, Word memo from it

steps.say: Download ufc_3_220_07.pdf from SharePoint (uploaded references) and give me a one-page Word memo on what it says about drilled shafts.

flows.title: Geotech page: two people; a calc package, 'what files do I have', 'send me the link'

steps.say: Compute the active earth pressure on a 4 m cantilever retaining wall holding back sand (phi = 30 degrees, unit weight 18 kN/m3) and save the calculation as a PDF calc package.
What files are in my working folder?
Send me the link to the calc package.

flows.title: Review page: a single-user process (DEV_IDENTITY), not the multi-user layout

steps.say: What is on this sheet?

flows.title: Geotech page, nobody signed in: the legacy single-user layout, Word table

steps.say: Give me a Word memo with a table of the Terzaghi bearing capacity factors Nc, Nq and N-gamma for phi from 0 to 40 degrees in 5-degree steps.
